decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>- 15-01 Plan December 2025<br>- 15-02 Plan December 2025<br>- 15-03 Elevations December 2025<br>- 15-04 Elevations December 2025<br>- 15-05 Elevations December 2025<br>- 15-06 Elevations December 2025<br>- 15-08 Block Plan January 2026<br>-&nbsp;PP-14659375v1 Site Location Plan 05 February 2026<br></p><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>

Secured by DesignThe proposed development shall follow secured by design
principles to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and
the Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local
Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the first occupation of
the approved development. All security measures applied to the approved
development shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Cycle ParkingPrior to first occupation, details of cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The proposed cycle parking spaces shall be designed and laid out in accordance with the guidance contained in the London Cycling Design Standards. The details approved shall be implemented prior to first occupation and retained for the lifetime of the development.

Refuse StoragePrior to first occupation, details of refuse storage shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The approved refuse storage shall be provided before the occupation of the development and thereafter permanently retained.

Vehicle Tracking Plan Prior to first occupation, a Vehicle Tracking Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include details of site access, and measures to ensure the safe movement of pedestrians and vehicles through the site. The details approved shall be implemented prior to first occupation and retained for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;&nbsp;
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
